title: Can green-fintech bibliometric reviews be re-run? A reporting audit and a test of metadata contamination
description: Code, derived data and results for a reporting audit of 15 green-finance and fintech bibliometric reviews (ten-item checklist built from BIBLIO, PRIBA, PRISMA-S and PRISMA 2020), a prevalence test of book-series metadata contamination across 50 Crossref and Semantic Scholar queries, and a repair of one 168-record Scopus corpus, with an OpenAlex/Crossref rebuild for comparison. Record-level Scopus exports and full-text PDFs are not redistributed.
